# Grant Manorial Land-Tax Rebate (nobles_estate)
oe_gov2_pa_nobles_tax_rebate = {
	type = country
	estate = nobles_estate
	importance = 1.8

	potential = {
		country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pa_nobles_tax_rebate }
	}

	on_accept = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pa_nobles_tax_rebate years = 5 mode = replace }
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
	}

	can_bribe = {
		can_bribe_default_trigger = yes
	}

	on_bribe = {
		on_bribe_default_effect = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 20
		subtract = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = scope:target value > 0.6 }
				}
				value = 12
			}
		}
	}

	chance = 10
}

		can_bribe_default_trigger = yes
	}

	on_bribe = {
		on_bribe_default_effect = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 20
		subtract = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = scope:target value > 0.6 }
				}
				value = 12
			}
		}
	}

	chance = 10
}

# Grant Tribal Caravan Escort Stipends (tribes_estate)
oe_gov2_pa_tribes_caravan_escort = {
	type = country
	estate = tribes_estate
	importance = 1.7

	potential = {
		country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pa_tribes_caravan }
	}

	on_accept = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pa_tribes_caravan years = 5 mode = replace }
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:tribes_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
	}

	can_bribe = {
		can_bribe_default_trigger = yes
	}

	on_bribe = {
		on_bribe_default_effect = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 20
		subtract = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = scope:target value > 0.6 }
				}
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}

	chance = 10
}
